personality: 7 Dark-First Utility with 6 Glass / Luxe DARK elements
personality_one_liner: A premium, high-contrast, performance-driven nutrition tracker that feels like a durable athletic tool with cinematic, glass-luxe polish.

spacing.rule: Strict padding around premium cards. 16px (lg) padding for standard cards, 24px (xl) screen edge margin. Use 8px (sm) for internal element grouping.

do's: Use heavy glass with a dark translucent tint (rgba(13, 15, 18, 0.85)) on the bottom tab bar and sticky headers.
Use glass overlay on the floating action button (FAB) for quick food add.
Apply glass effect to the onboarding/login modal cards over background imagery.
dont's: Do not use glass on standard data cards (use solid #1A1D23 for performance and readability).
Do not use light frosted glass; keep it dark, deep, and cinematic.

screens.name: Welcome/Login
screens.purpose: A cinematic entry point that establishes the premium brand and captures the signature designer stamp.

states.loading: Dark screen with a glowing #B8F34B minimalist spinner.

screens.layout: Full-bleed dark athletic background image (hero_athletic) layered with a top-to-bottom vertical gradient scrim (transparent to 90% #0D0F12). At the top: 'NUTRIFY / by Mauro Lainetti' in clean typography. Bottom 30%: 'Entrar com Google' button (pill shaped, primary brand color or glass), and the copyright footer '© 2026 Nutrify — Mauro Lainetti. Todos os direitos reservados.' pinned to safe area bottom.

screens.name: Onboarding
screens.purpose: Collect user metrics (name, sex, birth date, height, weight, goal, activity level) in a sleek, non-fatiguing flow.

states.error: Inline red validation text under inputs.

screens.layout: Multi-step flow. Top sticky progress bar (#B8F34B). Clean typography for the question (e.g., 'Qual é o seu objetivo principal?'). Large tappable cards (surfaceSecondary) for options. Bottom sticky 'Continuar' button pinned above keyboard. Use smooth fade-through transitions.

screens.name: Painel (Dashboard)
screens.purpose: The command center for daily macros, calories, and hydration, built for rapid scanning.

states.loading: Skeleton loaders matching the circular ring and macro bars.
states.error: Card displaying 'Erro ao carregar dados' with a retry button.

screens.layout: Scrollable feed. Top header (glass) with greeting and date. Hero module: Large circular progress ring for calories (remaining in center, stroke in #B8F34B) surrounded by three horizontal progress bars for Macros (Proteína, Carboidratos, Gordura). Below: Hydration tracker widget (water icons). 'Modo Atleta' active indicator chip if toggled. Pinned FAB (glass) at bottom right for quickly adding food.

screens.name: Diário (Food Diary)
screens.purpose: Detailed breakdown of the 6 daily meal categories and logged foods.

states.empty: Illustration of dark plate/food (food_empty_state) + 'Seu diário está vazio. Adicione sua primeira refeição.'

screens.layout: Segmented by categories: Café da Manhã, Almoço, Lanche, Jantar, Pré-treino, Pós-treino. Each category is a surfaceSecondary card with a header row displaying total calories for that meal, and a nested list of food items. Items show name, portion size, and calories. 'Adicionar alimento' button at the bottom of each section.

screens.name: Buscar / IA (Food Search & AI)
screens.purpose: Quickly find foods via Open Food Facts or AI photo recognition.

states.loading: Scanner animation (neon green laser line scanning up/down) or search skeletons.
states.empty: Camera viewfinder ready state, or 'Nenhum resultado encontrado' in text search.

screens.layout: Top toggle (glass segmented control) for 'Texto' vs 'Câmera IA'. Camera mode: Full-screen camera view with a dark UI overlay and a #B8F34B focus box. Text mode: Search input (surfaceTertiary) with instant list results below. Food result cards display macro splits instantly.

screens.name: Evolução (Reports)
screens.purpose: Visualize weight trends and nutritional consistency over time.
screens.layout: Interactive Reanimated charts. Top tab filter (Semana, Mês, Ano). Line chart for weight progression (neon green line on dark grid). Bar chart for daily calorie averages. Cards below showing TMB/TDEE stats based on the Mifflin-St Jeor equation.

screens.name: Perfil (Profile & Settings)
screens.purpose: Manage goals, Athlete Mode, and app settings.
screens.layout: List of settings rows (surfaceSecondary). 'Modo Atleta' gets a prominent toggle switch (highlighted to prevent double-counting exercise calories). Signature 'by Mauro Lainetti' placed elegantly at the bottom of the list.

hero_athletic.alt: grayscale photo of man working out

food_empty_state.alt: a black plate topped with three figs and a leaf

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly use #0D0F12 for main background and #1A1D23 for standard cards. Do not deviate to lighter greys or pure black.
Implement the vibrant green (#B8F34B) selectively for primary actions, active states, progress rings, and Athlete Mode highlights. It is a high-contrast focal point.
The UI is exclusively in Brazilian Portuguese. Ensure all labels, placeholders, and error messages are correctly translated (e.g., 'Painel', 'Diário', 'Café da Manhã').
For the Welcome screen and Profile/Settings, position 'NUTRIFY / by Mauro Lainetti' and the copyright text exactly as requested by the user, elegantly integrated.
Any image used as a background MUST have a top-to-bottom gradient scrim fading into #0D0F12 at >=80% opacity at the bottom so text stays fully legible.
Avoid using generic blue or purple colors for states. If info state is needed, use neutral greys (#4B5563) to keep the palette strict.
Ensure the charts and circular progress rings are animated using react-native-reanimated for a premium, buttery-smooth feel.
Do not use generic Material styling; rely on generous padding (16-24px), subtle border raduis (12-20px), and removing borders or using very dark borders (#2E333D) to separate elements.
